tagline: Understand clues that can make a message suspicious.
privacy_text: Analysis runs locally without sending text to an external API. Messages are not stored by default. Local history is optional and stores raw text only with explicit consent.
prevention_intro: Interactive practical guides: check off the safety habits you have verified and compare the examples.
prevention_reminder: One example or clue does not prove a scam by itself. When in doubt, verify through an official channel you find independently.
paste_label: Paste SMS, email, or message here
save_option: Save to local history (includes original text)
save_help: Off by default. Checking this box consents to local storage on this device.
not_saved: Not saved; text remains only in this session.
report_intro: Estimated language: {language}. Detection may be wrong.
no_signals: No configured patterns detected. This does not guarantee safety.
limits: Important: this report detects text patterns, not truth. Scams can go undetected and legitimate messages can trigger alerts. No links are opened and domain reputation is not checked.
history_local: Stored only in this app's local SQLite database.
about_text: SafeSignal is an educational tool using transparent rules, not an antivirus or a guarantee against fraud.
safety_note: If you shared banking data or a code, contact your bank using its official number.
custom_rules_intro: Create keywords or phrases to watch for. A match is a low-confidence clue, not proof of a scam.
rule_keyword: Keyword or phrase to watch for
rule_required: Please fill in all three fields.
custom_rule_note: Custom rules are stored in this installation’s local database. Keywords are matched without case sensitivity.
quiz_intro: For each example, choose the most likely option, then read the explanation. A message’s authenticity cannot always be established from text alone.
ocr_privacy: The image is processed on this device and is not sent to an API or saved by SafeSignal. This feature requires Tesseract to be installed locally.
ocr_upload_help: Accepted formats: PNG, JPG/JPEG and WebP. Maximum size: 8 MB.
ocr_result: Extracted text (you can copy it into the Analyze tab)
ocr_copy_hint: Review the extracted text: OCR can confuse characters, digits, or links.
ocr_no_text: No text was recognized. Try a clearer image or another language.
calibration_intro: Calculates metrics using the synthetic examples included in the repository.
calibration_note: Important: these results describe only this small artificial corpus. They do not measure real-world accuracy on everyday messages.
